legal.notice.s03.title: What we offer
legal.notice.s03.body: {product} runs debates between AI models on questions you ask, and gives an AI-written verdict. It is for adults (18+). It is not professional advice.
legal.notice.s04.title: Price and payment
legal.notice.s04.body: {product} is free. Paid plans are not available yet. Before any paid plan starts, this section will list the price (tax included), how and when you pay, when the service starts, how renewal works, and how to cancel.
legal.notice.s04.bodyPaid: The paid plans and their monthly prices are on the pricing page. The prices there are before tax; before you pay, the checkout shows the full price with your country's tax. You pay by card, every month in advance. A plan starts as soon as your bank confirms the payment and renews every month until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in Settings, or on the cancel page without signing in.
legal.notice.s04.payments: Card payments are processed by NETOPIA Payments. We never see or store your card number.
legal.notice.s05.title: Withdrawal and refunds
legal.notice.s05.body: When paid plans start, consumers in the EU and the EEA have a 14-day right of withdrawal, explained in section 13 of the Terms. For users elsewhere, the Terms say what applies where you live.
legal.notice.s05.bodyPaid: If you live in the EU or the EEA, you can withdraw from a paid plan within 14 days of subscribing, as section 13 of the Terms explains. You get back the price minus the part already used. For users elsewhere, the Terms say what applies where you live.
legal.notice.s06.title: Complaints
legal.notice.s06.body: Write to us first: {reports} to report illegal content, {legal} for any other complaint.
legal.notice.s06.adr: If you are a consumer in Romania or the EU, you can also use alternative dispute resolution through this website; we do not commit to take part:
legal.notice.s06.courts: Section 18 of the Terms explains which law applies and where disputes are heard.

legal.cookies.title: Cookies
legal.cookies.meta: All first-party · no advertising or cross-site cookies
legal.cookies.intro: We set only the cookies the service needs in order to work, so they are always on and there is nothing to switch off. We set no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and we will update this page before we add any other cookie.
legal.cookies.session.purpose: Keeps you signed in. It is renewed while you use the service.
legal.cookies.csrf.purpose: Stops other websites from submitting forms in your name.
legal.cookies.ageRefusal.purpose: After an age check is refused, stops this browser from trying again for 30 days. It holds only the word “refused”, no personal data.
legal.cookies.locale.purpose: Remembers the interface language you picked.
legal.cookies.storageTitle: Stored in your browser, not in a cookie
legal.cookies.storageIntro: Four items are kept in your browser's storage: two in local storage, until you clear it, and two in session storage, until you close the tab. Unlike cookies, they are not attached to your requests; the help-chat item holds a copy of a conversation you had with DebateAI's help, whose messages reached DebateAI when you sent them.
legal.cookies.consent.purpose: Remembers that you have seen the cookie notice, so it is shown once.
legal.cookies.mode.purpose: Whether you use the light or the dark display.
legal.cookies.languageOffer.purpose: Remembers, for this tab, that you declined the offer to show a debate in another language.
legal.cookies.supportConversation.purpos: Keeps your help-chat conversation on screen while the tab stays open. It is erased when someone signs in or signs out in this tab.
legal.cookies.refuse: To refuse them, block or delete cookies and site data for this site in your browser settings.
legal.cookies.refuseEffect: What then stops working: signing in, and the remembering of your language and display choices.
legal.providers.title: Model providers
legal.providers.meta: Who receives your text, why, where, for how long, and on what basis
legal.providers.intro: This Register is part of our Privacy Policy and applies to every user, wherever you live. To run a debate we send its text to the AI providers below, and what you type in the support chat goes to the support chat's model. They never receive your email address, your account, your IP address or your payment details. Our contracts exclude using your content to train their models [publish only once verified for each provider]. We tell you before a new provider receives any data. Square brackets mark facts we have not confirmed yet.

legal.health.title: Consumer health data privacy policy
legal.health.meta: For residents of Washington, Nevada and Connecticut
legal.health.s01.title: What this policy covers
legal.health.s01.body: Some US state laws, including Washington's My Health My Data Act, require a separate policy for consumer health data. This page is that policy; our privacy policy covers everything else.
legal.health.s02.title: Health data we may process
legal.health.s02.body: We do not ask for health data. It reaches us only if you type it into a question or a challenge, for example in a debate about a treatment you are having.
legal.health.s03.title: Why we process it
legal.health.s03.body: Only to run and store that debate and, if you choose, to publish it. We never use it for advertising and we never sell it.
legal.health.s04.title: Who receives it
legal.health.s04.body: The AI providers that run your debate receive its text; the Model providers page lists them. Our hosting provider stores it for us. We share it with no one else.
legal.health.s05.title: Your rights
legal.health.s05.item1: confirm whether we hold your consumer health data and get a copy of it;
legal.health.s05.item2: get the list of every third party that received it;
legal.health.s05.item3: withdraw your consent and have it deleted.
legal.health.s06.title: How to use them
legal.health.s06.body: From Settings, or by writing to privacy@dezbatere.ro. We reply within 45 days. If we refuse a request, you can appeal by replying to our answer.
